entries.name: Gorvak, Orc Warchief
entries.weak: Low Wisdom saves — Hold Person worked
entries.abilities: Two greataxe swings a turn. A war cry that let the orcs near him attack again.
entries.notes: Leads the Blackfang tribe. Wants the old watchtower back. Swore to come for Din personally.

entries.name: Lizardfolk Shaman
entries.weak: Went down fast once we closed to melee
entries.abilities: Cast Entangle and something that summoned swamp animals. Turned into a crocodile.
entries.notes: Carried a bone totem — Cassian kept it. The tribe may want it back.

entries.name: Githyanki Knight
entries.abilities: Silver greatsword, three attacks. Misty Step at will. Told the DM "you can't" when we tried to charm it.
entries.notes: Way above our level — we ran. Looking for something the party is carrying.

entries.name: Priestess Vaelra
entries.type: drow, priestess of the Spider Queen
entries.abilities: Summoned a web of darkness. Carries a scourge. Never seen her fight for real.
entries.notes: Offered a deal: safe passage for the totem. Not to be trusted, but she kept her word once.

entries.name: Sergeant Rhogar
entries.abilities: Breath weapon, a line of fire.
entries.notes: Owes us a favour for the smugglers. Knows who runs the docks. Likes strong ale.

entries.name: Durra Ironbraid
entries.notes: Sells silvered weapons at 100 gp over cost. Can repair the cracked shield in two days.

entries.name: Whisper
entries.notes: Sells rumours for 10 gp each. Half of them were true. Real name unknown.

entries.name: Owlbear
entries.abilities: Beak and claws in the same turn.
entries.notes: No picture yet — this one shows what an entry looks like without one.

entries.name: The thing in the cellar
entries.weak: Backed away from the cleric's holy symbol
entries.abilities: Walked through the wall. Its touch drained strength.
entries.notes: We know almost nothing. Ask the priest in town.
